justification: Pure in-memory property-based testing engine (generators, shrinking, runner, strict JSON and TFV readers) and coverage-guided fuzz engine (mutators, campaign, corpus runner). The library performs no filesystem, network, process, environment, clock or FFI access; the CI flag is a parameter. The tests only read the committed pbt-v1 and fuzz-v1 fixtures and the Go fuzz reference-vector table.
